name: rutacuadrilla
description: Sistema full-stack geoespacial para asignar recorridos y registrar trabajo de campo
author: Cristóbal Alexander Vergara Vergara

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/domain && npm run build --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/api && npm run build --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/admin && npm run build --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/field
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run secrets:check
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/domain && npm run dev --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/domain && npm run test --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/api && npm run test --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/admin && npm run test --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/field && npm test --prefix spikes && npm run test:tools
scripts.test:tools: npm run build --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/domain && node --test tools/database-snapshot.test.mjs tools/h40-sync-delay-proxy.test.mjs tools/demo-route-data.test.mjs tools/serve-h40-field-artifact.test.mjs tools/start-demo.test.mjs tools/verify-h40-evidence.test.mjs tools/provision-initial-admin.test.mjs tools/provision-initial-admin.postgres.test.mjs tools/verify-vps-pilot.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/admin && npm run typecheck --workspace=@rutacuadrilla/field
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
